entry_points.text: Open creates a context with fresh log, pick loads a mount root into reconfigure params, config validates before bounded copies; boot helpers mount, pivot or unmount resolved paths with permission checks.
New mounts resolve type and subtype, build and parse a legacy context, check capability and insert pinned; remount uses a masked context under write protection; legacy move resolves and delegates.
State switch swaps pointers under task and sequence cover and frees the prior object at last reference; early setup installs the top overmount as root and cwd.

exports.text: Config reset releases option ownership and restores neutral defaults for reuse.
Type helpers convert internal class, dirent encoding and mode-derived values, yielding unknown when out of range.
Parameter layer parses typed values including integers, enums, strings, descriptors and block devices, with path lookup and optional block-device enforcement.
Pins insert into superblock and mount sets, remove with completion, and group cleanup drains the head under read-side cover.
Error reporting defers to worker context with dual notification; context logging records prefixed errors.
Mount core reports creation privilege, converts propagation forms, and shares beneath-risk and empty-dir tests across units.

hazards.text: Name release tolerates absent or error values; group pin cleanup needs external progress; mand-lock warns once and is ignored; timestamp warnings fire once per superblock.

FSPICK cloexec, nofollow, no-automount, empty-path; FSCONFIG flag, string, binary, path, path-empty, file, create, exclusive create, reconfigure; lookup, phase, superblock, mount and propagation bits with user and locked masks; malformed EINVAL, denial EPERM, contention EBUSY, loops ELOOP, first expiry EAGAIN, unknown type ENODEV, name shortage ENOMEM.

invariants.text: Filenames enforce a length ceiling, use inline storage with heap fallback, apply empty-path policy with audit capture, and free by references.
Key match prefers polarity alignment with fallback and narrow negation; booleans accept 0/1 and common words; ownership maps unsigned values in caller scope.
Mount needs admin capability in the owning scope; restricted types need noexec/nodev or a compatible visible mount; empty dirs need dedicated vectors.
Bind and copy accept attached or valid anonymous sources, deny unbindable, RCU-unsafe, locked-shadowed and namespace-loop trees; moves add beneath, sharing and ancestor denials.

Mount and remount sanitize flags, preserve outside user mask, deny locked relaxation, hold writers for read-only entry, gate by capability, report busy or access failures, and split forced warn-through from strict cancel.
Error pool refuses allocation in teardown, issues cleared work-ready events and recycles with final wakeup; log reads separate empty from oversized and advance the tail.
Root redirection scans threads, skips kernel and exiting tasks, and swaps only matching entries; namespace teardown notifies and defers reclaim; notify lists depend on configuration.

locks.text: Pin membership serializes on a dedicated spinlock with completion signaled after detachment.
Task root, cwd and use count use a sequence lock held exclusively for mutation and sampled for copy or replace.

User mutex serializes one context; writers exclusion spans acquisition and reconfig; mount, namespace and hash guards cover surgery with pointer-bit hold and barriered markers; release downgrades for delivery then drops refs after grace.

state_machines.text: Contexts move among create params, creating, awaiting mount, reconfigure params, reconfiguring and failed; dispatcher finishes pending cleans and routes commands, sending params to parsing only in param states.
Read-only entry holds writers before marking and always releases, exit clears directly; unmount separates expiry, force, root and detach with busy handling and deferred reclaim past delivery.
Mount notify compares prior and current namespace links to emit attach, detach, same-namespace move or cross-namespace transfer, then syncs the stored link.

structs.text: Fs state pairs path refs with count reclaim, copies creation mask, starts single-owned with mask 0022; dirent indexing masks type bits with fixed shift; error pool defaults to 32 entries.

Context files support message read and release; contexts carry phase, exclusivity, root, type, namespace, ops, security blob, flags and log; params hold key plus flag, string, blob, path or file value.
Namespaces track owner, origin, visible list and tree root with emptiness from root; mounts link parent, master, share and slave state plus expiry, notify and unmount queues.
